payload.blocks: Phase 2 (argv window) of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner, and phases 3, 6 and 7 behind it.
payload.headline: Phase 2 workers cannot run cargo: grant Bash(cargo/node) to claude units in project config, or run it unconfined?

parts.cause: core/config-standard/runner.yaml starts claude workers (claude-cli-bwrap) with only '--permission-mode acceptEdits' and no --allowedTools list, so headless claude asks for approval on Bash(cargo ...) and nobody answers. No fgos run flag adds tools for one unit. The supervisor and the lead have no verb to change that list or to sync a worktree, and no unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is live.

options.does: Add --allowedTools 'Bash(cargo:*)' 'Bash(node:*)' 'Bash(npm test:*)' to the claude-cli-bwrap invocation in .fgos/config.yaml (config patch), then the lead reruns the unit.
options.gain: Phase 2 resumes on the next wake; every later Rust unit stops hitting the same wall.
options.harm: Every claude unit in this project may run cargo/node (still inside bwrap, and the runner still commits only declared writes).
options.label: Allow cargo and node for claude workers in project config

options.cost: One manual session, about 1-2 hours of agent time.
options.does: You (or an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR you start) sync p02 with main and run the phase 2 unit outside the sandbox.
options.harm: Needs you at the keyboard; the next Rust unit hits the same block.
options.label: Run phase 2 once in an unconfined session

options.does: Open a backlog item for a per-Unit allowed-tools field; phase 2 waits until it lands.
options.harm: Phases 2, 3, 6 and 7 stay stopped for days.
options.label: Park phase 2 behind a per-unit tool grant

parts.recommendation: Option 1: it applies your earlier 'allow cargo' answer through the existing config door, stays inside bwrap, and unblocks the rest of the plan without you having to be present.

scope.allows: One config patch to the claude-cli-bwrap invocation's allowed tools in .fgos/config.yaml, and a rerun of the phase 2 unit.
scope.forbids: Any change to bwrap confinement, git write grants for workers, other executors, or the plan's scope.

parts.what: You answered q-nog2h4wfjm with 'widen footprint, allow cargo'. The footprint is widened, but the rerun unit c-7867-1795535626766 came back blocked again: the claude worker refuses every cargo command with 'This command requires approval'. The p02 worktree is also 66 commits behind main.
